world.topic:
A trial of this host before a real round, nothing else: check that the target world can be continued with the images this host has, and that both of its positions work in it.

Only the position that keeps the held-out tasks, the task-setter, does this; every other position, the judge included, has nothing to do in this world and ends its turn at once.

1. Make a world of your own continued from rw_313df9cf84a4 (state root issue-312-target) at its checkpoint c0. Its configuration is that world's own (`config show`) with only what has to change: the workers of paper-repo and internal-review-repo are the cand-g2 files in /initial-state/inputs/1/cand-g2/; worker.image and worker.environment_image are the full image IDs /initial-state/inputs/1/README.md lists for paper_29; "resources": []; budget.total_seconds 900; worker.max_executions 2; worker.max_model_seconds 300. If a command refuses it, read the refusal, change only what it names, and say so.
2. Drive it (`execute <world> --loop`) and wait for it to end.
3. Then end it: it does not release, so `stop <world> --release`.
4. Push one file, trial.md, to your repository's main: the commands you ran, each refusal word for word and what you changed for it, the world id, each turn's position and outcome, and whether paper-repo's turn found /workspace/input.

No judging, no release.
